question: Can the existing Wingless substrate learn and autoregressively generate a deterministic relation directly over the full 0..255 raw-byte alphabet without tokenization, while generalizing to exact two-byte contexts omitted from training?
hypothesis: A fixed 64-counter bit-factorized byte learner trained on 75% of exact two-byte contexts will achieve at least 0.95 held-out one-step accuracy and at least 0.95 autoregressive accuracy across the frozen held-out contexts, while an exact-byte-context memorization control trained on the same observations will achieve at most 0.01 held-out one-step accuracy. Slice-backed and ring-backed context substrates will remain exactly equivalent.

prior_evidence.scientific_claim: Bounded factorized learned state generalized multiple learned next-token rules to held-out exact contexts with perfect autoregressive generation.

authority: research-only; no production, broker, live, accepted-ref, credential, runner-configuration, scheduler, queue-consumer, external-model inference, or cross-lane authority changes

raw_input.encoding: identity byte values; no tokenizer, vocabulary remapping, chunker, subword model, UTF decoding, external embedding, or learned boundary mechanism
raw_input.target_visibility: used only for deterministic corpus generation/scoring; learner sees only observed byte triples

factorized_learner.learned_state: for each of 8 bit positions, a 2x2x2 uint32 count tensor over (older_bit,newer_bit,target_bit), totaling 64 counters
factorized_learner.update: increment one target-bit count per bit position for each training byte triple
factorized_learner.prediction: per bit choose target bit with larger learned count; ties choose zero; reassemble eight bits

memorization_control.learned_state: one exact-context predicted-byte slot plus seen flag for each of 65536 possible two-byte contexts
memorization_control.update: store the deterministic observed next byte for a trained exact context; conflicting observations are invalid
memorization_control.prediction: return stored byte when seen, otherwise zero
memorization_control.purpose: tests whether held-out performance can be explained by exact-context memorization rather than learned byte composition

train_holdout_split.factor_coverage_requirement: for every bit position all four older/newer bit combinations occur in training
train_holdout_split.leakage_policy: no held-out exact two-byte context may appear in training

seed_policy: All four seeds were checked against the Wingless repository before preregistration and had no matches. Seeds affect only deterministic ordering; no replacement, exclusion, or extension is permitted.

training.observations: each of the 49152 training contexts exactly once per seed and substrate
training.deterministic_order: seeded permutation of the frozen training context set

evaluation.one_step: score factorized and memorization-control predictions on all 16384 held-out exact contexts without updates
evaluation.autoregressive: from a deterministic 1024-context subset of held-out starts per seed, run 16 steps; each factorized prediction becomes the next context byte while the XOR law independently supplies the scored target

controls: Both substrates receive byte-for-byte identical ordered training observations and held-out starts.
No tokenizer, segmentation, learned chunk boundary, external embedding, or external model is used.
The exact-context memorization control receives exactly the same training observations.
Training mutates only fixed-size learned state; evaluation is read-only.
Autoregressive evaluation feeds model predictions, not targets, back into context.
No capacity growth, oracle corrections, gradient optimizer, post-result threshold changes, or seed replacement.

budgets.goroutine_policy: single-process deterministic execution; GOMAXPROCS=1 in qualification

validity_criteria: Exact parent SHA and North Star SHA-256 match this preregistration.
All four seeds and both context substrates complete frozen training/evaluation cardinalities.
The external input alphabet is the complete uint8 range and is presented without tokenization or remapping.
No held-out exact two-byte context appears during training.
Every two-bit input combination occurs in training for every one of eight factor positions.
The factorized learner remains exactly 64 uint32 counters; no capacity growth occurs.
Autoregressive evaluation feeds factorized predictions back into raw-byte context.
The normalized result carries schema wingless.research-scientific-result.v1 and the exact experiment identifier.
Full Go regression passes before probe execution.

classification_rules.supported: All sixteen frozen metric thresholds and all validity criteria pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity/completeness pass and factorized held-out performance materially exceeds memorization control, but at least one factorized accuracy or exact cross-substrate threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but raw-byte factorization does not materially outperform exact-context memorization or fails autoregressive generation.
classification_rules.incomplete: Environmental or compute interruption prevents frozen cardinality; preserve diagnostics and make no scientific claim.
classification_rules.invalid: Provenance, raw-byte identity, split isolation, bounded-state, determinism, construction, or qualification isolation fails; invalid is not a scientific outcome.

stop_conditions: Stop before execution on provenance, authority, North Star, package-scope, or split-isolation drift.
Stop as invalid on held-out leakage, missing bit coverage, byte remapping/tokenization, learned-state cardinality drift, memorization conflict, or non-deterministic qualification.
Do not stop early for apparent support, mixed, or negative observations; complete the frozen matrix unless infrastructure prevents it.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: After any probe or primary output is observed, do not alter seeds, raw-byte alphabet, split rule, target law, factorization, memorization control, context width, corpus size, autoregressive subset, metrics, thresholds, aggregation, classification, or stop conditions under this experiment identifier.
